description: Claims that were withdrawn or refuted after verification. scripts/check_withdrawn_claims.py fails any pull request that adds a line repeating one of them. A line is allowed when it cites the claim as withdrawn or corrected (see allow_line_markers), or sits on a verbatim or archive path (see allow_paths). Add a claim here the day it is withdrawn.
allow_line_markers: (?i)withdrawn|refuted|\bfalse\b|corrected|correction|superseded|do not plead|don.t plead|do not cite|do not repeat|not established|\bnot a director|struck|~~|⛔|if .{0,20}does(n.t| not) use
